newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lam Soon sees offers for M.C. Packaging.
newsitem.headline: Lam Soon sees offers for M.C. Packaging.

text.p: Lam Soon (Hong Kong) Ltd said on Wednesday it had received a number of written offers for its controlling stake in M.C. Packaging (Hong Kong) Ltd but no formal agreement has yet been reached.
Lam Soon said the offer indications were being studied carefully and the prospective buyers included several well-known multinational corporations.
Depending on the structure of the transaction, any buyer of the interest may be obliged to make a general offer to shareholders of M.C. Packaging, Lam Soon added.
In July, the company appointed CS First Boston (Hong Kong) Ltd as advisor on the possible sale of its controlling interest in M.C. Packaging.
Lam Soon held 50.3 percent of M.C. Packaging as in April.
Lam Soon shares fell HK$0.01 to HK$1.39 around midday and M.C. Packaging shares were down HK$0.025 to HK$2.975.
